title: I made a browser game where you drift a shopping cart through neon city streets
author: kounaille
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’ve been working on a small game called **Caddie Club**: you ride a shopping cart and drift it through night city tracks (a boulevard, a mall, an underground parking lot, a warehouse...).

Everything in this game was made with AI (Claude): the code, the tracks, the cart, the effects, even the music, which is generated in code. The only things not made with AI are a few asset packs, used for some of the city props and for the riders and their animations.

It runs in the browser, on PC with keyboard and on phone.

I’d love your feedback, especially on how the drift feels. You can play it here: [https://www.crazygames.com/fr/game/caddie-club](https://www.crazygames.com/fr/game/caddie-club)

Thanks!
